verdict: SOURCE_GAP_CONFIRMED; existing assigned public CLI case can reproduce it without new API, DTO, database shape, command, acceptance ID, or fixture infrastructure.

sourceGap.finding: In resumePending, when target.utcDay differs from the current virtual UTC day, retryAt === null immediately returns the unchanged denied row. This occurs before reading a later quota snapshot, so unknown-reset work can never recover even after a new authorized available observation.

smallestCliReproducer.existingSurface: toy probe.run -> accountingProbe -> public ModelAdmission observe/inspect/inspectPending/resumePending, existing TestClockControl, disposable PostgreSQL fixture and owner reopen
smallestCliReproducer.sequence: Add a separate fixed account in the existing case: persist an exhausted observation with no windows/reset and a denied row at 23:59 UTC; reopen and verify the exact old pending row and zero charge at 00:02; verify clock-only, unavailable, stale, or unauthorized data still returns that unchanged row; at 00:06 observe fresh authorized schema-valid available windows and require one idempotent current-day retry with unchanged original bindings.
smallestCliReproducer.caseBoundary: Keep the same deferred-restart-recovery check ID and all four AT-ops-10 mandatory IDs; use compact bounded booleans/counts within the existing CheckView projection limit. Do not add a test selector or fixture path.

smallestFreshnessGuard.unknownReset: Do not synthesize a reset time or treat midnight as a reset. Require the latest observation to be non-null, authorized, schema-valid, available, for the same account, reported strictly after the persisted original denial time (target.startedAt), and no later than the current virtual wall. Preserve ModelAdmissionPolicy's 15-minute freshness check, measured mode, and eligible decision before reserving.
smallestFreshnessGuard.knownReset: Preserve the current guard: the virtual wall must reach retryAt and the available observation must be reported at or after retryAt.
smallestFreshnessGuard.blockedResult: Until those conditions hold, return the exact original denied row without retry or charge. Keep current queue-head, budget/root binding, snapshot compare, immutable retry, canonical request hash, current-day idempotency, and no-send settlement guards.
